outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each point is an individual sample (n=141); histograms show distributions, not means requiring individual overlay.
Scatter plot of per-cell-line mean ± s.d. with error bars showing variability; scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay per the check criteria.
Line/density (Gaussian fit) plots showing distributions of averaged parameters; line plots are exempt since overlaying individual points would be unreadable.

Box plot already showing distribution (quartiles, whiskers, median, outliers); box plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay, and the image additionally shows individual sample dots.
Polar histogram displaying a probability distribution of phase differences over time, not a bar chart of means; histogram-type distribution plots are exempt.
Polar histogram averaged by subtype showing a probability distribution, exempt as a distribution-type plot rather than a mean bar chart requiring individual points.
Line plot of an example fitted signal illustrating the decay model; not a summary of averages across replicates, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
Scatter plot where each marker is an individual sample (n=117) with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional individual point overlay.
